_meta.description: The request repository: work submitted for assignment. 'area' references expertise_areas[].id. 'attachments[].path' is relative to the data/ folder. 'created_minutes_ago' is converted to an absolute created_at when the seed is loaded, so 'time since created' is meaningful on every fresh start. The 'sim' block is NOT business data: it only scripts how the simulated routing engine and contributors behave so each use case can be demonstrated deterministically. Real submissions omit 'sim' and get the engine's default behaviour (5-20s latency, 20% never return).
_meta.estimated_effort_hours: PROVISIONAL requester estimate of work needed. Used for capacity only until the assigned contributor confirms their own estimate (see engine_config.estimates); unconfirmed use is buffered x1.25 and labelled as such.

sim_schema.routing: normal | hang | late_return | random   (random = engine default: 20% hang). hang = never returns. late_return = returns after sim.late_return_seconds, long after an operator would reasonably have intervened.
sim_schema.forced_pick: Optional contributor id the engine selects when routing returns (must be eligible).
sim_schema.contributor_response: accept | decline | fail   (what happens once the assignment is offered). fail = assignment breaks before work begins (e.g. contributor goes offline).
sim_schema.estimate: Optional scripted contributor estimate behaviour once assigned: {mode: with_accept | after_reminder | never, after_reminders (for after_reminder), hours_total, confidence: high|medium|low, basis: similar_work|spec_review|rough_guess}. Default if omitted: with_accept using the requester estimate.
sim_schema.status_check: Optional scripted reply to a contributor status check-in: {reply: on_track | at_risk | blocked | no_response, progress_percent, hours_remaining, note}. Only used once the task is accepted.
